## README.md
# Nature's Contributions to People (NCP) — biodiversity & natural habitat

Global NCP indicators from Chaplin-Kramer et al. (2019) — integer scores counting the
Nature's Contributions to People a location ranks highly for. Two layers:
- **`ncp_biod_nathab`** — NCP weighted by biodiversity & natural habitat (0–20)
- **`ncp_only`** — NCP alone (0–19)

Source rasters are 2 km **World Eckert IV** (equal-area); reprojected to **WGS84** for
the COG assets and aggregated to **H3 resolution 7** by area-weighted **mean**.

## Assets

| Asset | Format | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `ncp-biod-nathab-cog` / `ncp-only-cog` | COG (WGS84) | `…/public-ncp/NCP_{biod_nathab,only}_4326_cog.tif` |
| `ncp-biod-nathab-hex` / `ncp-only-hex` | H3 hex (res 7, mean) | `…/public-ncp/hex/{ncp_biod_nathab,ncp_only}/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

Each hex layer is one row per `h7` cell (parents `h6/h5`, partitioned by `h0`), gap-free.
The value column (`ncp_biod_nathab` / `ncp_only`) is the area-weighted **mean** indicator —
an intensity: aggregate with `AVG`/`MIN`/`MAX`, **never `SUM`**.

## Querying (DuckDB)

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
-- Mean NCP-biodiversity score within an AOI given as h7 cells
SELECT AVG(n.ncp_biod_nathab) AS mean_ncp
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-ncp/hex/ncp_biod_nathab/h0=*/data_0.parquet') n
SEMI JOIN aoi_h7 m ON n.h7 = m.h7;
```

Query `h7` directly — no `GROUP BY`/`AVG` collapse needed (one row per cell). This
replaces the prior res-8 point-binned build, which left coverage gaps and ~1 row per
source pixel.

## Citation

Chaplin-Kramer, R., et al. (2019). Global modeling of nature's contributions to people.
*Science*, 366(6462), 255–258. doi:10.1126/science.aaw3372
